messages:
sasha: alert: hosted-euc1 GPU pool admission p95 queue = 11.2s, admission_reject_rate = 18% over 5m. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/pool/euc1?view=admission :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Incident ID INC-1749127890 created by monitoring · severity: high · runbook: infra/gpu-pools/admission-control.md
matt: seeing the same in logs. KV cache hit rate dropped ~40% at the same time. Any recent deploys to euc1? :thinking_face:
jia: no deploys. I see a flurry of short-lived connections from 10.3.12.0/24 -> egress SNAT pool. Could be SNAT exhaustion causing proxy retries and backpressure. grabbing 5m tcpdump now.
leo: can you paste the proxy/egress error lines?
jia: log excerpt:
```
2025-11-03T14:12:23Z proxy-frontend-7f8c9 ERROR dial tcp 10.3.12.45:443: connect: network is unreachable
2025-11-03T14:12:24Z proxy-frontend-7f8c9 WARN upstream retry count=3 latency=320ms
2025-11-03T14:12:25Z proxy-frontend-7f8c9 ERROR snat: no free slots
```
sasha: that snat line looks suspicious. SNAT exhaustion would cause long tail retries -> admission. Could also explain KV cache miss surge.
anika: quick mitigation options: 1) enable cross-region spillover to hosted-euc2 for best-effort traffic 2) increase SNAT NAT pool (infra change) 3) temporarily relax admission thresholds to reduce rejects (costly).
matt: prefer 1 + 2. Spillover to euc2 buys time while infra increases NAT pool size. Anyone able to flip routing?
infra-oncall: I can enable spillover for the next 20m. Running command:
```
infra-cli routing spillover enable --from=hosted-euc1 --to=hosted-euc2 --policy=best-effort --ttl=20m
```
ops-bot: action queued: infra-oncall requested routing spillover. Approvals: automated (policy allows emergency routing).
jia: meanwhile I'm scaling the proxy DaemonSet to add more NAT peers and applying a small iptables tweak. Patch I'm applying:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/snatchat --patch '{"data":{"snat_pool_size":"512"}}'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/proxy-frontend
```
leo: heads up that increasing snat_pool will increase ephemeral IP usage and cost. Tagging finance for a quick FYI.
anika: also reduced admission reject threshold from 0.25 -> 0.35 in hosted-euc1 config to lower immediate rejects. Posting curl patch:
```
curl -X PATCH https://control.redwood/api/v1/admission/hosted-euc1 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"reject_threshold":0.35}'
```
matt: after spillover + snat bump + admission tweak, p95 started dropping. Current metrics: p95 queue 2.1s, reject_rate 2.3%.
sasha: nice. leaving spillover on for 20m then revert. followups: run postmortem, look at long-term fix: autoscale SNAT nodes, add SNAT exhaustion alert, revisit admission smoothing to avoid oscillation.
infra-oncall: marking INC-1749127890 as resolved. Notes: root cause probable SNAT exhaustion amplified by sudden KV cache churn from a single customer job set. CC @finance for cost note.
ops-bot: INC-1749127890 status -> resolved · duration 00:11:34 · runbook steps followed: spillover, snat_pool increase, admission threshold adjust.
matt: will file PR to add SNAT exhaustion alert + dashboard panel. jia will add a test to simulate short-lived connection spikes.
sasha: thanks team :thumbsup: closing thread.
